answer: Lock identity to a pigment sequence that must arrive in order: each epoch the beacon emits a spectral slot (red→green→blue…), and an identity must submit a proof whose color matches the current slot before the jetty closes; skipping a color or reusing a past hue voids the entire chain. A beacon of honest agents advances one hue per epoch; a clone swarm forced to paint the same spectrum pays N× the pigment cost, while honest agents only buy one pigment per epoch.
